test-work-wo-control.mjs: mock replaced rather than chained context handlers; chain them as Pi does and explicitly select ultracompact instead of inheriting global user mode.

decisions.title: before_agent_start also fires for sendMessage triggerTurn runs (messageType union)
decisions.rationale: 1.2.0: runs started by pi.sendMessage(..., { triggerTurn: true }) now emit before_agent_start with messageType "custom" and the starting message, before that message's message_start (agent-session.js _prepareRun). work-models.ts:3721-3725 marks every before_agent_start as a user prompt (pendingPromptBackedAgentStart = true). A custom run is therefore treated as user work, and the internal background-notice guard (work-models.ts:3732-3760) never aborts it. The unit test in test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs (around line 197) still passes only because it replays the pre-1.2 order without before_agent_start. Today the guard covers only the retired knowledge discoverer (launchKnowledgeDiscoverer has no production caller), so the fix stays minimal: a custom run is not marked as prompt-backed, plus one 1.2-ordered unit case. Research-mode prompt sections now also reach custom runs, which is intended. advisor-model.ts, jev-tools.ts:511 and work-images.ts:267 work for both kinds. CU-03.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs: Pi 1.2-ordered custom-run case fails before the fix, passes after (commit 84a45f3).

decisions.title: Pin the devDependency types to the runtime 1.3.0
decisions.rationale: package.json devDependencies pins @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 1.1.0 for editor and LSP types, while the runtime is 1.3.0. CU-03 reads event.messageType, which 1.1.0 types lack. The catch-up tool also reads this pin as 'Installed'. Bump it to 1.3.0 exactly and keep package-lock.json in sync. Dev-only; nothing ships at runtime. CU-04.
decisions.verification: npm install --save-dev --save-exact @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@1.3.0: package.json and package-lock at 1.3.0; C2 passes after updating the assistant fixture for 1.3.0 estimateTokens (commits 1808861, bfee8bb).

decisions.title: Session counts as busy while a run starts; sendUserMessage needs deliverAs then; sendMessage queues into the starting run
decisions.rationale: 1.2.0: ctx.isIdle() is false during start and before_agent_start. A triggerTurn sendMessage in that window joins the starting run instead of failing with 'Agent is already processing'. plan3-web.ts:39-42 already sends steer when !ctx.isIdle(). work-models.ts:2730-2738 and plan3.ts:697 pass deliverAs. work-models.ts:2244 sends after compaction completes, from an idle session. Our triggerTurn wakes (work-camera-watch.ts:44, plan3-night.ts:66) gain the queueing fix with no change.

decisions.title: Codemode: input-constraint tags, elapsed time, @options must be the first line, two-worker admission, node --watch bridge, quadratic text() join
decisions.rationale: 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 change how Pi declares and runs codemode scripts. ce-workflow never generates codemode scripts. Its tools (jev_*, process_image, generate_image) are called from scripts, and Pi generates their declarations from the existing schemas. Nothing to change.

decisions.title: reachesTools and namespace aliases on tool definitions
decisions.rationale: 1.2.0: a tool that calls other tools may declare which ones a call can reach. The MCP extension uses this to wait for servers and to decide whether a replacement codemode or tool_search reaches MCP tools (docs/extensions.md). jev-tools.ts:469 runs only bash through ctx.executeTool and never MCP tools, so declaring it changes nothing.

decisions.title: Model switching drops thinking from other models; serializeConversation omits thinking
decisions.rationale: 1.3.0 drops earlier models' thinking blocks on a model switch. 1.2.0 drops thinking from compaction and branch-summary serialization. The STRIP_THINKING filter (work-models.ts:1757, 1988) is a separate opt-in context experiment. Plan3 advisors run in fresh child sessions. No duplicate logic to delete, nothing to add.

decisions.title: ctx.ui.custom overlay done() closes its own overlay
decisions.rationale: 1.3.0 fix: done() used to close the topmost overlay, which could leave another extension's dialog unresolved. The vendored ask_user overlays (extensions/ask-user/index.ts:543, 557) get the fix automatically. The repo has no workaround to remove.

decisions.title: Resumed sessions keep their active tools
decisions.rationale: 1.3.0 restores tools activated during the session on resume. The only setActiveTools caller, plan3.ts:1270 (adds plan3_design), now survives a resume as intended.

decisions.title: Provider, catalog, retry, MCP, OpenRouter, Kimi, Nix, config-schema, clipboard, /share, --model ambiguity, tool-argument parsing and print-mode fixes
decisions.rationale: 1.2.0 and 1.3.0 provider and runtime fixes and features owned by Pi. ce-workflow ships no themes or theme $schema, does not parse `pi mcp list`, and its scripts pass provider-qualified --model ids and use RPC mode, not -p. Benefits arrive automatically.

decisions.title: Verified private workflow generation
decisions.rationale: The official stable release is translated into the complete private nine-workflow generation with no ordinary CE runtime surface.

decisions.title: Idle-parent wake prompt text changed to 'Inspect subagent updates above. …'
decisions.rationale: 0.77.0 rewrote PARENT_WAKE_TEXT (installed src/shared/parent-wake.js:1) to a longer instruction. work-compaction.ts:449-453 syntheticWakePrompt matches only the 0.76.1 text 'Subagent updates above.'. New wake prompts are therefore kept as protected user requests in compaction summaries and memory (work-compaction-memory.ts:62), which is the problem the 0.76.1 adoption fixed. Match the old and new exact texts, since old sessions still hold the old one. CU-01.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-compaction.mjs: both the old and new wake texts are classified as synthetic (commit 9fda699).

decisions.title: Post-compaction resume now goes through the shared parent wake
decisions.rationale: 0.77 and 0.78: when background runs are active and the parent is idle, pi-subagents appends the hidden 'Compaction is complete. Resume the parent task now…' message without a trigger, then wakes with PARENT_WAKE_TEXT as a user prompt (src/extension/index.js around line 1040). work-models.ts blocks the resume by its text. before_agent_start resets the block for the wake prompt (work-models.ts:3722), so the guard no longer works. The user decided to let pi-subagents resume: the guard existed for the removed ce-workflow goal loop (Decisions D1). Delete the compaction-resume guard and keep the summary-hygiene regex in work-compaction.ts. CU-02.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs: the input-hook regression case passes; live C5 with Pi 1.3.0 and openai-codex/gpt-6-luna passes (commit a1f357b).

decisions.title: subagent schema moves rare fields into options; launch by name with did-you-mean errors
decisions.rationale: 0.77.0: the tool description now says to launch by name with an exact provider/id. Unknown agents or models fail with suggestions, so list and models are needed only on demand. Top-level management fields still work: subagent-options.js flattens them and schemas.js:44 allows extra properties. The launches in plan3.ts:563 and work-models.ts:1236 (context: "fresh") and the model:thinking suffix that advisor-model.ts sets need no change. The research advisor prompt (work-models.ts:491) still tells the model to call action:list capabilities:true and action:models first. Per Decisions D2, drop that clause and claim no savings. CU-05.
decisions.verification: node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs asserts that the advisor prompt has no action:list or action:models (commit bfee8bb).

decisions.title: bg_wait and subagent_supervisor are declared only after delegation
decisions.rationale: 0.79.1 leaves these tools undeclared until subagent is enabled or other background work registers. Plan3 ideas, review and the research advisors call subagent (after subagents_enable) before any wait, which turns them on. No ce-workflow code calls or lists them.

decisions.title: Forks reuse the parent prompt cache, get <subagent_instructions> and see parent context
decisions.rationale: 0.78.0 and 0.79.0 change only context: "fork" children. Every ce-workflow launch uses context: "fresh" (plan3.ts:563, work-models.ts:491, 1236).

decisions.title: Built-in reviewer, oracle and evidence-auditor skip the acceptance report unless acceptance is passed
decisions.rationale: 0.78.0. Research advisors use oracle for read-only critique and read its reply text. plan3-advisor is ce-workflow's own agent. Neither wants an acceptance report.

decisions.title: Shared idle wake with pi-intercom; Esc keeps the parent stopped
decisions.rationale: 0.77 and 0.78: one wake reservation per session (Symbol.for("pi.idle-wake.v1")), and completions after Esc no longer restart the parent. ce-workflow's own wakes use sendMessage triggerTurn, which Pi 1.2 queues into a starting run. Joining the reservation contract would add coupling to a private symbol for no observed problem.

decisions.title: Handoff ownership, reuseFrom, finished-child resume, RPC snapshot fields, launcher sandboxes, program status, tmux inspector, parallel workflow, pinToolDeclarations, activeRunsPrompt, PI_SUBAGENTS_COMPONENT_UI, run-history removal, watchdog and runner fixes
decisions.rationale: 0.77.0 to 0.79.1 features and fixes inside pi-subagents. The hub runs Pi as `--mode rpc` (hub/src/rpc-client.ts:33) and renders ask_user forms, not custom TUI components, so PI_SUBAGENTS_COMPONENT_UI does not apply. Plan3 uses only fresh async advisors. The benefits arrive automatically.

decisions.title: Recognize answered, skipped and cancelled decision batches
decisions.rationale: Grade: Adopt. Reversibility: Tier 1 result-normalization rollback. Bottom line: recognize 0.16.0 batch answers without treating a successful batch as unavailable, and honor an explicit Pause/Wait selection in an answered batch. Project fit: recordWorkGoalAskUserResult currently requires details.response and incorrectly sets unavailable for every batch; askUserPauseSelection reads only the single result. Coded dirty/improvement approvals remain intentionally single-question and reject batches. Upstream evidence: README Result details, public schema and index.ts executeBatch define aligned questions/answers with answered or skipped status and empty answers on cancellation; malformed/UI failures throw. Benefit: independent decision batches work safely with work-goal continuation; skipped questions remain unresolved. Cost/risk: validate full alignment and require every question answered before clearing fallback-unavailable. Confidence: high. Recommendation: adopt now with single/batch/cancelled/skipped/pause regression cases. tooTechnical:false.
decisions.verification: PASS: node scripts/test-work-goal.mjs; node scripts/test-work-compaction-notifications.mjs. Regression cases cover single, complete batch, skipped, cancelled, malformed alignment and Pause/Wait.

decisions.title: Retarget the optional remote-answer patch to the abortable UI lifecycle
decisions.rationale: Grade: Adopt. Reversibility: Tier 1 patch-helper rollback. Bottom line: retarget the opt-in patch to current public UI lifecycle using an abortable race; do not mutate the installed package during catch-up. Project fit: packaged scripts/patch-ask-user-remote-answer.mjs and test-work-ask-remote.mjs promise remote answers but installed 0.16 is unpatched, env flag unset; test assumes a patch even when disabled. External evidence: captured ask-user diff and current execute(), dialog options and runCustomPrompt signal cleanup. Benefit: preserve optional single-question remote answering without leaking losing UI and make default verification independent of installed patch state. Cost/risk: batch remote answering remains unsupported and local UI remains available; patch must still fail loudly on anchor drift. Confidence: high. Recommendation: adopt with temp-source patch/idempotence and abort-race checks. tooTechnical:false.
decisions.verification: PASS: node scripts/test-work-ask-remote.mjs. Patches installed 0.16 source in memory only, asserts idempotence, syntax, anchor-drift rejection, winning-side races, abort cleanup and listener disposal. Live opt-in TUI/intercom interaction not exercised; installed source remains untouched.

decisions.title: Shared idle-wake reservation (idle-wake.ts); wake text unchanged
decisions.rationale: 0.17 moves the wake into a reservation shared with pi-subagents. The prompt is still 'New intercom message above.' (installed index.ts:1312), which work-compaction.ts already treats as synthetic. Nothing to change.

decisions.title: Delivery receipts, E_SESSION_HELD, /intercom-pool, broker liveness drop, bare-reply targeting, Windows fsync fix
decisions.rationale: 0.17.x broker and protocol changes. ce-workflow's only integration, work-ask-remote.ts, emits intercom:outbox-request and reads intercom_message details.from.id and bodyText. Neither changed in the diff, and it does not read delivery results. No stableId or PI_INTERCOM_* use in the repo.

decisions.title: Inherit pi-goal recovery, stale-context, settings, and documentation fixes
decisions.rationale: Grade: Not-our-problem. Reversibility: Tier 1 package rollback. Bottom line: keep pi-goal 0.54.8 package-owned and make no ce-workflow compatibility adapter. Verified project fit: ce-workflow's coexistence path only reads the canonical custom goal-state entry and sends public /goal pause and /goal resume commands; the installed persistence source still serializes data.goal under customType goal-state, and the public commands remain unchanged. Verified upstream evidence: the installed 0.54.8 README, managing-goals and settings references, package metadata, source, and captured 0.54.4-to-0.54.8 artifact show internal transient-stream classification, stale extension-context cancellation, menu/settings lifecycle, and documentation/build changes while preserving the coexistence surface. Benefit: pi-goal users receive safer recovery and lifecycle behavior without duplicate state ownership. Cost/risk: ordinary upstream regression exposure. Confidence: high. Recommendation: no local adapter.

decisions.title: 4.4.0 to 4.4.4: Pi 1.2 and 1.3 support, unavailable or disabled LSP reported as unconfirmed, read-guard, cascade and performance fixes; tool surface unchanged
decisions.rationale: Reviewed from the installed CHANGELOG.md because the diff artifact timed out. ce-workflow only names lens tools (read_symbol, read_enclosing, module_report, lens_diagnostics) for compaction classification (work-compaction.ts:237, 291-306; work-models.ts:1822). Those names and parameters are unchanged. Reporting a file no server answered for as unconfirmed matches the 4.3.0 decision not to treat inconclusive LSP results as clean. No local shim.
